source.notes: Source .gas filename in original DS2 Logic.ds2res archive.

name.notes: Display name of the item template.

base_name.notes: Base item type name for affix naming synthesis.

pcontent_allowed.notes: Determines if item can spawn via dynamic procedural loot. Curse currently generates loot via ItemDb tables without evaluating pcontent_allowed flags.

allow_modifiers.notes: Determines whether magical prefixes/suffixes can roll on this base item. Curse affix generation does not evaluate this flag.

variants.notes: List of variant definitions with level and icon tiers; parsed into ItemDef.levels.

requirements.notes: Discipline level requirements (single requirements supported; compound and passives unsupported).

slot.notes: es_weapon_hand, es_shield_hand, es_chest, es_head, es_forearms, es_feet (es_spellbook unsupported, rings/amulets have empty slot string in source catalog).

class.notes: IST_FIGHTER, IST_RANGER, IST_CMAGE, IST_NMAGE, IST_ALL, IST_MAGE.

set.notes: Reference to parent set ID. Curse lacks set bonus tracker and set completion evaluation.

icon_reference.notes: Original DS2 bitmap texture reference string.

attack.is_melee.notes: Flag distinguishing melee attacks from ranged attacks.

attack.is_two_handed.notes: Flag indicating weapon occupies both hands and unequips shields.

attack.reload_delay.notes: Attack delay / recovery period in seconds.

attack.attack_range.notes: Maximum targeting/firing distance in world units (7.5 to 11.0 meters).

discipline_offset.notes: Supported for single discipline level requirement offset from item level.

discipline_fixed.notes: Supported for fixed discipline level requirements.

alternative_or.notes: Pipe-only OR: satisfied when any clause is met. Enforced by the real equip path. Mixed comma and pipe expressions stay explicitly unsupported (fail closed) because DS2 precedence is unverified.

conjunction_and.notes: Comma-only AND: every clause must be met. Enforced by the real equip path. Mixed comma and pipe expressions stay explicitly unsupported (fail closed) because DS2 precedence is unverified.

passive_rank.notes: Checks the member's learned passive rank. Source passives Curse does not implement (for example dual_wield) fail closed.

character_level_uber.notes: Checks the member's character level (uber), including #item_level offsets.

attribute_threshold.notes: Checks effective STR/DEX/INT including worn attribute bonuses.

equipment_durability.rationale: Curse design explicitly avoids equipment degradation and repair chore loops; gear does not lose durability.
equipment_durability.source_equivalent: Not used in core DS2 combat gear; confirmed excluded from Curse.

separate_consumable_ammo.rationale: Curse bows and crossbows fire unlimited basic ammunition; quivers/arrows are not separate inventory equip slots.
separate_consumable_ammo.source_equivalent: DS2 bows have built-in arrows and reload delays without separate inventory arrow items.

tetris_inventory_rotation.rationale: Curse jewelry and charms occupy standardized slot tiles; arbitrary multi-cell rotational Tetris is excluded.

spellbook_spell_slots.rationale: Curse implements active abilities via dedicated action bar skill slots; equip-slot spellbooks with nested spell pages are not implemented.
spellbook_spell_slots.source_equivalent: DS2 es_spellbook equipped book holding active spells.
